title: 1823 Prairie's doorway drawn to its full height, under a cornice hood
items: The Dent house at 1823 Prairie: the front door is now 3.5 m tall, the same as in the old engraving of the house. A tall glazed transom light sits over the door leaves, as the engraving draws it.
The doorway is capped with a stone frieze and cornice hood on two scrolled consoles, like the windows beside it.
